hook: Smoking isn't the only risk factor here
caption: The 'only smokers get oral cancer' myth has been outdated for years. HPV is now the leading cause in adults under 50, and it doesn't care whether you've ever touched a cigarette. Most people diagnosed with HPV-related oral cancer had no idea they were at risk. That's the part worth paying attention to. A free, 2-minute risk screener is available at oralcheck.org.
